categories.label: Basic
categories.blurb: The cuts and dissolves every edit is built from.

categories.label: Slide & Push
categories.blurb: One shot moves the other out of frame.

categories.label: Zoom
categories.blurb: Push in, pull out, land on the next shot.

categories.label: Blur & Motion
categories.blurb: Whips, smears and camera energy across the cut.

categories.label: Wipe
categories.blurb: An edge or a shape reveals the next shot.

categories.label: Creative
categories.blurb: Glitch, light, ink and liquid — the ones people notice.

categories.label: 3D & Spatial
categories.blurb: The frame becomes a surface in space.

dissolve.name: hold

dissolve.hint: Linger at the halfway blend before completing.

dip-color.name: hold
dip-color.label: Hold
dip-color.hint: How long the frame sits at full colour.

dip-color.name: blend
dip-color.label: Blend
dip-color.hint: Dip replaces the picture; flash adds light to it.

noise-dissolve.name: seed

wipe-radial.name: centreY

wipe-radial.hint: Where the transition originates, down the frame.

wipe-clock.name: centreY

slide.name: slices

slide.name: stagger

slide.hint: Delay each slice behind the one before it.

zoom.name: centreX

perspective-3d.name: push

transitions.label: Cut
transitions.description: A hard cut — removes any transition at this edit point.

transitions.label: Cross Dissolve
transitions.description: The classic blend. Softens a cut without drawing attention.

transitions.label: Fade
transitions.description: The incoming shot rises out of what is beneath it.

transitions.label: Soft Dissolve
transitions.description: A long dissolve that lingers at the halfway blend.

transitions.label: Fade to Black
transitions.description: Down to black, then up into the next shot.

transitions.label: Fade to White
transitions.description: Up to white, then back down into the next shot.

transitions.label: Dip to Black
transitions.description: Holds on black long enough to feel like time passed.

transitions.label: Dip to White
transitions.description: Holds on white — a clean break between two ideas.

transitions.label: Push Left
transitions.description: The next shot shoves this one out to the left.

transitions.label: Push Right
transitions.description: The next shot shoves this one out to the right.

transitions.label: Push Up
transitions.description: The next shot rises from below and lifts this one away.

transitions.label: Push Down
transitions.description: The next shot drops in from above.

transitions.label: Slide Up
transitions.description: The next shot slides up over this one and settles.

transitions.label: Slide Left
transitions.description: The next shot slides in from the right and settles.

transitions.label: Slide Right
transitions.description: The next shot slides in from the left and settles.

transitions.label: Slide Down
transitions.description: The next shot drops in from above and settles.

transitions.label: Split Slide
transitions.description: The frame arrives in two halves from opposite sides.

transitions.label: Multi Slide
transitions.description: Bands sweep in one after another from alternating sides.

transitions.label: Zoom In
transitions.description: The next shot lands from oversized down to frame.

transitions.label: Zoom Out
transitions.description: The next shot grows in from small.

transitions.label: Smooth Zoom
transitions.description: A gentle drift in — barely there, but the cut stops feeling hard.

transitions.label: Punch Zoom
transitions.description: A hard, fast punch onto the beat.

transitions.label: Centre Zoom
transitions.description: Rushes out of the centre of the frame at full force.

transitions.label: Directional Zoom
transitions.description: Zooms towards one side, so the move reads as travel.

transitions.label: Lens Zoom
transitions.description: A zoom with a touch of roll, like a hand-held lens pull.

transitions.label: Zoom Blur
transitions.description: Streaks pull out of the centre and resolve into the shot.

transitions.label: Blur
transitions.description: The next shot resolves out of a soft blur.

transitions.label: Motion Blur
transitions.description: The frame arrives smeared along its travel and settles sharp.

transitions.label: Directional Blur
transitions.description: A pure lateral smear that sharpens into place.

transitions.label: Radial Blur
transitions.description: Streaks rush outward from the centre before the shot lands.

transitions.label: Spin Blur
transitions.description: The frame arrives spinning and settles still.

transitions.label: Whip Pan Left
transitions.description: A hard camera whip to the left that lands on the next shot.

transitions.label: Whip Pan Right
transitions.description: A hard camera whip to the right that lands on the next shot.

transitions.label: Whip Pan Up
transitions.description: A vertical whip — the natural one for a 9:16 edit.

transitions.label: Whip Pan Down
transitions.description: A downward whip that drops onto the next shot.

transitions.label: Speed Blur
transitions.description: Heavy horizontal streaking, like a whip-pan held one beat longer.

transitions.label: Camera Shake
transitions.description: An impact shake that settles into the next shot.

transitions.label: Spin
transitions.description: The next shot spins down out of nowhere and lands square.

transitions.label: Wipe Right
transitions.description: A clean edge sweeps left to right.

transitions.label: Wipe Left
transitions.description: A clean edge sweeps right to left.

transitions.label: Wipe Up
transitions.description: The edge sweeps upward from the bottom of frame.

transitions.label: Wipe Down
transitions.description: The edge sweeps down from the top of frame.

transitions.label: Diagonal Wipe
transitions.description: The edge crosses the frame corner to corner.

transitions.label: Soft Edge Wipe
transitions.description: A wipe with a wide feather — halfway to a dissolve.

transitions.label: Circular Wipe
transitions.description: A circle opens out of the centre and fills the frame.

transitions.label: Iris Close
transitions.description: The old shot closes to a point and the new one is behind it.

transitions.label: Clock Wipe
transitions.description: A hand sweeps around the frame like a second hand.

transitions.label: Shape Wipe
transitions.description: A diamond opens out of the centre of the frame.

transitions.label: Star Wipe
transitions.description: A star grows out of the centre — playful and unmistakable.

transitions.label: Split Wipe
transitions.description: The frame splits down the middle and opens outward.

transitions.label: Barn Door
transitions.description: Two panels close in from the edges to the centre.

transitions.label: Blinds
transitions.description: Vertical slats open one after another.

transitions.label: Glitch
transitions.description: The signal tears apart and reassembles as the next shot.

transitions.label: RGB Split
transitions.description: Colour channels fly apart and snap back together.

transitions.label: Flash
transitions.description: A blown-out flash of light on the cut.

transitions.label: Light Leak
transitions.description: Warm light bleeds across the frame the way it does on film.

transitions.label: Film Burn
transitions.description: The frame burns through, the way a stuck film print does.

transitions.label: Pixel Dissolve
transitions.description: Blocks of the new shot arrive at random until it is whole.

transitions.label: Mosaic
transitions.description: The picture resolves out of coarse blocks into detail.

transitions.label: Ripple
transitions.description: Rings spread out from the centre and settle.

transitions.label: Warp
transitions.description: The frame bends through heat haze and straightens out.

transitions.label: Distortion
transitions.description: A violent short-wavelength wobble that tears and resolves.

transitions.label: Stretch
transitions.description: The frame stretches in from a smear and snaps to size.

transitions.label: Liquid
transitions.description: The picture unwinds out of a swirl.

transitions.label: Kaleidoscope
transitions.description: Mirrored wedges fold back into a single frame.

transitions.label: Page Turn
transitions.description: The old shot peels away like a page.

transitions.label: Luma Fade
transitions.description: The bright parts of the next shot arrive first.

transitions.label: Ink Reveal
transitions.description: The next shot bleeds through like ink through paper.

transitions.label: Flip Horizontal
transitions.description: The frame flips over on its vertical axis.

transitions.label: Flip Vertical
transitions.description: The frame flips over on its horizontal axis.

transitions.label: Card Flip
transitions.description: A hard-perspective flip with a shaded back face.

transitions.label: Cube Rotate
transitions.description: The shots sit on adjacent faces of a cube that turns.

transitions.label: Door Open
transitions.description: The frame swings open in two panels.

transitions.label: Door Close
transitions.description: Two panels swing shut on the next shot.

transitions.label: Fold
transitions.description: The frame concertinas open like a folding screen.

transitions.label: Perspective Slide
transitions.description: The shot slides in along a plane that is angled away from you.

transitions.label: Tunnel
transitions.description: The next shot rushes at you out of the distance.

transitions.label: Carousel Rotate
transitions.description: The shots swing past on a carousel.
